newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Jan CPI seen at prelim 0.2 pct m/m, 2.6 y/y.
newsitem.headline: Italy Jan CPI seen at prelim 0.2 pct m/m, 2.6 y/y.

text.p: Italian January consumer prices are seen at 0.2 percent month on month and 2.6 percent year on year, according to analysts' estimated based on preliminary data from 11 sample cities.
Final December data showed CPI growing a month on month rate of 0.1 percent and a year on year rate of 2.6 percent.
In January 1996, when national statistics institute Istat introduced a new basket of goods for CPI calculation, inflation was 0.1 percent month on month and 5.5 percent year on year.
Analysts had forecast a month on month rate of 0.1 percent and yearly gain of 2.5/2.6 percent after the first two cities, Trieste and Turin, released their data on Monday.
The 11 cities have a total weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index.
Final national CPI data are due from Istat on February 4.
